notes.title: RAFFLE: Get ready for the Walker apocalypse!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625296/970444c46b03a7f3a24b543cb3dae81f23fab930.jpg

Dear constructors and engineers,
 
Get ready for the upcoming launch of Bridge Constructor: The Walking Dead! We have teamed up with Alienware and AMC to run a raffle, offering these awesome prizes:


 an Alienware M15 Gaming-Laptop 
 an Alienware Elite Gamer Bagpack 
 an Alienware AW988 Wireless Headset
 a bunch of official AMC's The Walking Dead merchandise
 and 10 Steam keys for the game!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625296/bcdb3726279b84b62006303fc298f13d18c8dcd8.jpg
 
How to take part? Just follow this link to our raffle page on Gleam and follow the instructions: http://bit.ly/BridgeConstructor_TheWalkingDead_raffle
 
Good luck! See you all in the game very soon!
Until then, all the best and stay healthy!
ClockStone & Headup


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1336120
